text:
maria: kicking off config-only rollout for beta cohort now — microbatch.size 8 -> 12, batch.window_ms 35 -> 50, routing weight tweak for beta-geo. will canary at 5% for 20m. change window: tonight 17:10-23:00 UTC. please ack and call any hard rollback triggers.

deploybot: ACK. starting canary (id cb-812345). target=beta-cohort, traffic=5%, duration=20m. health checks enabled, automatic rollback disabled (ops decision).

ryan: quick Q — which metrics are we explicitly watching? p50/p95/p99, error_rate, kvcache_hit_ratio, queue_depth?

anita: +1 on those. also watch evictions, throttles, and model output error logs. add tail latency (p99.9) to watchlist.

sam: note: increasing batch.window_ms should reduce per-token cost but could raise tail latency for short prompts. keep cost-per-token on the dashboard.

leo: propose rollback criteria: error_rate > 1% sustained for 3m OR p95 > 800ms for 5m OR queue_depth increase > 2x baseline for 5m. Anyone object?

maria: sounds good. adding automated alert thresholds to the runbook now. also pin config to runtime digest rtd-3ef4 so we can quickly revert.

deploybot: canary started at 17:12 UTC. status: health=OK, deploy_agent_online=true, 0/3 health failures. logs stream: https://internal/streams/cb-812345

ryan: seeing a small kvcache pressure bump at ~2m into canary (0.42 -> 0.6). snippet: ```{"kvcache_pressure": 0.60, "time": "17:14:30"}```

anita: that's expected during initial warmup for the increased microbatch size. watch steady-state at 10m.

sam: if p95 climbs above 700ms for >5m we should hotpatch batch.window_ms -> 40ms and re-evaluate. saves a full rollback.

maria: agreed. condition noted: hotpatch threshold p95>700ms for 5m. ops to execute hotpatch if triggered.

deploybot: canary health update @17:32 UTC: p95=210ms, p99=480ms, error_rate=0.03%. canary green for 20m. ready to scale to 25% per plan unless any objections.

leo: please ensure pin remains to model v3.1.2 for beta cohort to avoid model mismatch with routing policy.

maria: pinned and documented in release notes draft. short release notes: "Config-only: microbatch size increased to 12 and batch window to 50ms for beta cohort to improve throughput; routing weights adjusted for beta-geo; rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100% with metrics gates; rollback & hotpatch thresholds listed in runbook."

ryan: I've wired alerts: pager if error_rate > 0.5% for 2m, slack channel alert for p95>650ms. dashboards: https://internal/dash/config-rollouts/cb-812345

anita: will watch observability and call if anomalous. also added a synthetic load test to run at 30% step.

deploybot: scaling canary to 25% at 18:00 UTC (staged over 10m). new status at 18:10 UTC: health=OK, p95=230ms, error_rate=0.04%.

sam: secondary check: cost-per-token down ~6% vs baseline for this cohort. no quality regressions spotted in sampled outputs.

maria: 2hr checkpoint: metrics stable. moving to 100% gradual rollout over next 6h, with the same gates active. leaving rollback policy active (manual rollback only).

deploybot: rollout completed to 100% at 00:20 UTC. final status: health=OK, p95=245ms, error_rate=0.05%, kvcache_hit_ratio steady.

leo: logged pin and rollout metadata to release board and attached changelog entry: "cfg-rollout-812345".

sam: adding note for retrospective: add synthetic prompt set to catch quality regressions next time and document hotpatch steps in runbook.

maria: thanks all — clean rollout. :thumbsup:
